description: Create a private job-application package and register a new package in the private tracker.

# Generate Local Job Package

When this toolbox is imported as `toolbox/`, use the private workspace workflow defined in `toolbox/AGENTS.md`.

1. Read `AboutMe.md` and `Job-Applications/<company>/job.txt` from the private workspace root.
2. Select Senior SRE Engineer, AWS Solutions Architect, or Engineering Manager.
3. Create or refresh `thinking.md`, `cv.md`, `prep.md`, and `email.md` or `cover-letter.md` in the company folder.
4. Maintain `Job-Applications/Tracker.csv`: add a missing company as `Prepared — review required`; never overwrite an existing user-managed status.
5. Do not alter inputs, submit an application, send email, or commit private files.
